# appgatesdp_stats_appliances (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `descending` (String) Whether the sorting is applied descending or ascending. Defaults to certain field depending on the object type.
- `order_by` (String) The field name to sort the result list. Supported fields vary from object to object. Defaults to certain field depending on the object type.
- `query` (String) Query string to filter the result list. It's used for various fields depending on the object type. Send multiple query parameters to make the queries more specific.
- `range` (String) 'Range string to limit the result list. Format: -. 3-10 means the items between the (including) 3rd and the 10th
 will be returned. Defaults to all objects.'

### Read-Only

- `appliance_count` (Number) The number of active Appliances in total.
- `connector_count` (Number) The number of active Appliances with the Connector role enabled.
- `controller_count` (Number) The number of active Appliances with the Controller role enabled.
- `creation_date` (String) The time the stats was generated. Deprecated as of 6.4 Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23.
- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `filter_by` (Attributes List) The filters applied to the list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter_by))
- `gateway_count` (Number) The number of active Appliances with the Gateway role enabled.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `log_forwarder_count` (Number) The number of active Appliances with the LogForwarder role enabled.
- `log_server_count` (Number) The number of active Appliances with the LogServer role enabled.
- `name` (String) User-friendly name for the stats. Deprecated as of 6.4 Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23.
- `portal_count` (Number) The number of active Appliances with the Portal role enabled.
- `queries` (List of String) The queries applied to the list.
- `refresh_interval` (Number) Recommended refresh interval in minutes. Deprecated as of 6.4 Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23.
- `total_count` (Number) The total readable count of entities. Not influenced by the query. Supported in API versions: v24.

<a id="nestedatt--data--network"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.network`

Read-Only:

- `busiest_nic` (String) The name of the NIC that's most used.
- `dropin` (Number) Number of inbound packets dropped for the whole uptime.
- `dropout` (Number) Number of outbound packets dropped for the whole uptime.
- `ips` (Map of List of String) IPs of the Appliance per NIC.
- `rx_speed` (String) The speed of the inbound network activity on the busiest NIC. The average is taken for the last 10 seconds.
- `tx_speed` (String) The speed of the outbound network activity on the busiest NIC. The average is taken for the last 10 seconds.
